categories.name: Power and CPU
categories.about: How hard the processor is allowed to work, and what Windows switches off to save energy.

categories.name: Graphics
categories.about: How Windows schedules the GPU and presents frames from games.

categories.name: Network
categories.about: Latency and background bandwidth: what else is using your connection while you play.

categories.name: Mouse and keyboard
categories.about: Raw, predictable input with no pop-ups that steal focus mid-game.

categories.name: Background apps
categories.about: Apps and features that run when you didn't ask them to.

categories.name: Services
categories.about: Windows services you may not need. Each one is switched to Disabled, never deleted.

categories.name: Look and feel
categories.about: Animations and effects that make the desktop feel slower than it is.

categories.name: Privacy
categories.about: Ads, suggestions and data collection. Small speed effect, big quiet effect.

categories.name: System and security
categories.about: Deep changes to how Windows protects itself. Real gains on some CPUs, real trade-offs on all of them.

presets.name: Recommended
presets.about: Safe changes with a clear benefit. Good for every PC.

presets.name: Competitive
presets.about: Recommended, plus Advanced changes that trade power use and convenience for lower latency.

presets.name: Extreme
presets.about: Everything, including changes that lower Windows security. Only for a PC that is just for games.

tweaks.name: Keep USB devices awake
tweaks.what: Stops Windows putting USB ports to sleep to save power. Fixes mice, headsets and controllers that drop out or lag for a moment after sitting idle.
tweaks.tradeoff: Laptops use slightly more battery.

tweaks.name: Turn off Fast Startup
tweaks.what: Fast Startup makes Shut down a half-hibernate, so drivers and Windows never get a clean start. Turning it off means Shut down really shuts down.
tweaks.tradeoff: Cold boots take a few seconds longer.

tweaks.name: Keep the CPU at full speed
tweaks.what: Sets the minimum processor state to 100%, so the CPU doesn't have to ramp its clock up when a game suddenly needs it.
tweaks.tradeoff: More heat and power use at idle. On laptops, fans may spin more.

tweaks.name: Turn off core parking
tweaks.what: Keeps every CPU core available instead of letting Windows park idle ones. Can smooth out frame times when a game's load jumps between cores.
tweaks.tradeoff: Higher idle power use.

tweaks.name: Aggressive CPU boost
tweaks.what: Tells the CPU to use its turbo boost as soon as there's work, rather than waiting to see if the load sticks around.
tweaks.tradeoff: Runs hotter. On thin laptops it can hit thermal limits sooner.

tweaks.name: Turn off PCI Express power saving
tweaks.what: Stops Windows lowering the power state of the link to your graphics card and NVMe drive between bursts of work.
tweaks.tradeoff: A few watts more at idle.

tweaks.name: Turn off power throttling
tweaks.what: Windows slows down apps it thinks are in the background. This stops it, which helps when a game's launcher, voice chat or capture app gets throttled.
tweaks.tradeoff: Background apps use more power. Takes effect after a restart.

tweaks.name: Turn off hibernation
tweaks.what: Removes the hibernation file, which is often 6 to 25 GB on drive C:. Also turns off Fast Startup.
tweaks.tradeoff: No Hibernate option. Laptops that hibernate on low battery will shut down instead.

tweaks.name: Keep drives spinning
tweaks.what: Stops Windows powering down drives after a few minutes idle, so a game doesn't hitch while a hard drive spins back up.
tweaks.tradeoff: Hard drives use a little more power and make a little more noise.

tweaks.name: CPU energy preference: performance
tweaks.what: Tells the processor to favour speed over saving energy when it decides how fast to run.
tweaks.tradeoff: More heat and power use, especially on laptops.

tweaks.name: Never let the CPU idle
tweaks.what: Keeps every core out of its sleep states. Shaves the wake-up delay some competitive players chase.
tweaks.tradeoff: The CPU runs hot and loud all the time and uses a lot more power. Never on a laptop.

tweaks.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.what: Lets the graphics card manage its own memory and scheduling. Required for DLSS Frame Generation; on other games the effect is small either way.
tweaks.tradeoff: A few older drivers and capture tools behave badly with it. Takes effect after a restart.

tweaks.name: Turn off Xbox Game Bar
tweaks.what: Stops the Game Bar overlay and its capture features from hooking into every game you start.
tweaks.tradeoff: No Win+G overlay, no clips from Game Bar. Your own capture app is unaffected.

tweaks.name: No Game Bar pop-ups
tweaks.what: Stops the "Press Win+G" tip from showing when a game starts.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: Prioritize games in the multimedia scheduler
tweaks.what: Windows has a scheduler profile just for games that it barely uses by default. This raises its CPU priority and I/O priority to High.
tweaks.tradeoff: Background audio or streaming apps can get less time while a game runs.

tweaks.name: Give games more CPU time
tweaks.what: Windows reserves 20% of CPU time for background tasks while multimedia apps run. This lowers the reservation to 10%.
tweaks.tradeoff: Background tasks get less time during games.

tweaks.name: Favor the window you're using
tweaks.what: Gives the app in front shorter, more frequent turns on the CPU, so a game gets scheduled sooner after input.
tweaks.tradeoff: Background work such as encoding or downloads can run a little slower.

tweaks.name: Turn off fullscreen optimizations everywhere
tweaks.what: Makes fullscreen games use real exclusive fullscreen instead of a borderless window in disguise. Some older DirectX 11 games feel more responsive this way.
tweaks.tradeoff: Alt-Tab is slower and some overlays won't show over the game.

tweaks.name: Turn off multiplane overlay
tweaks.what: A known fix for flicker, black flashes and stutter on some NVIDIA multi-monitor setups. Leave it alone if you don't have those problems.
tweaks.tradeoff: Slightly higher GPU use for video playback. Takes effect after a restart.

tweaks.name: Block Game DVR everywhere
tweaks.what: Turns off Windows game recording with a policy, so no app or update can switch it back on.
tweaks.tradeoff: Xbox Game Bar can't record clips at all.

tweaks.name: Longer GPU timeout
tweaks.what: Gives the graphics driver 10 seconds instead of 2 before Windows decides it has hung and resets it. Fixes "display driver stopped responding" in heavy games and on overclocked cards.
tweaks.tradeoff: A genuinely frozen GPU takes longer to recover. Takes effect after a restart.

tweaks.name: Turn off Fault Tolerant Heap
tweaks.what: If a game crashes a few times, Windows quietly runs it with a slower, safer memory allocator from then on. This stops that.
tweaks.tradeoff: A game that really is unstable may crash more often instead of running slower.

tweaks.name: Stop sharing updates with other PCs
tweaks.what: By default Windows can upload update files to other PCs. On a slow upload connection that shows up as ping spikes. Updates still download from Microsoft.
tweaks.tradeoff: None for most people.

tweaks.name: Turn off Remote Assistance
tweaks.what: Stops other people being invited to view or control this PC through Remote Assistance. Fewer open doors.
tweaks.tradeoff: You can't receive help through Remote Assistance until you turn it back on.

tweaks.name: Turn off network throttling
tweaks.what: Windows limits network processing while media plays so audio doesn't glitch. This removes the limit.
tweaks.tradeoff: On very old CPUs, audio can crackle under heavy network load.

tweaks.name: Turn off Nagle's algorithm
tweaks.what: Sends small packets right away instead of bundling them. Helps games that use TCP (some MMOs and older titles). Most shooters use UDP and won't change.
tweaks.tradeoff: A little more network overhead. Applies to your active network adapters; takes effect after a restart.

tweaks.name: Stop Store apps updating in the background
tweaks.what: Microsoft Store apps stop downloading updates on their own while you play.
tweaks.tradeoff: You update Store apps yourself from the Store's Library page. Games from the Xbox app are affected too.

tweaks.name: Keep Windows Update away from drivers
tweaks.what: Stops Windows Update replacing your graphics driver with an older or generic one.
tweaks.tradeoff: You update drivers yourself, from NVIDIA, AMD or Intel.

tweaks.name: Ask before downloading Windows updates
tweaks.what: Windows tells you updates are ready instead of downloading and installing them in the middle of a session.
tweaks.tradeoff: Security updates wait for you. Install them regularly.

tweaks.name: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
tweaks.what: Some games and launchers connect faster or more reliably over IPv4. IPv6 still works when it's the only option.
tweaks.tradeoff: None for most people. Takes effect after a restart.

tweaks.name: Faster copies over your home network
tweaks.what: Turns off bandwidth throttling for file sharing, so copying from a NAS or another PC isn't held back.
tweaks.tradeoff: None on a home network.

tweaks.name: Turn off mouse acceleration
tweaks.what: Turns off Enhance pointer precision, so the same hand movement always moves the same distance. The single biggest change for aim consistency.
tweaks.tradeoff: The desktop pointer feels slower at first. Takes effect after you sign out.

tweaks.name: No Sticky Keys pop-up
tweaks.what: Pressing Shift five times no longer throws you out of the game to ask about Sticky Keys. Same for Filter Keys and Toggle Keys.
tweaks.tradeoff: None. You can still turn these on in Accessibility settings.

tweaks.name: Shortest key repeat delay
tweaks.what: Holding a key starts repeating sooner. Mostly noticeable in menus, chat and text.
tweaks.tradeoff: Easier to type a letter twice by accident. Takes effect after you sign out.

tweaks.name: No shake to minimize
tweaks.what: Shaking a window while you drag it no longer minimizes everything else.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: No typing insights
tweaks.what: Windows stops collecting statistics about how you type.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: Stop apps running in the background
tweaks.what: Store apps such as Weather, Phone Link and Mail stop running when they're closed.
tweaks.tradeoff: Those apps won't show live notifications until you open them.

tweaks.name: Stop Microsoft Edge running in the background
tweaks.what: Edge preloads itself at sign-in and keeps running after you close it. This stops both.
tweaks.tradeoff: Edge opens about a second slower.

tweaks.name: Turn off Widgets
tweaks.what: Removes the Widgets board and the news feed process that keeps it filled.
tweaks.tradeoff: No weather or news on the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Turn off Copilot in Windows
tweaks.what: Removes the Copilot sidebar and its background process.
tweaks.tradeoff: You can still use Copilot in a browser.

tweaks.name: No startup delay
tweaks.what: Windows waits about ten seconds after sign-in before starting your startup apps. This removes the wait.
tweaks.tradeoff: If you have many startup apps, they all compete for the first few seconds.

tweaks.name: Turn off Recall
tweaks.what: Stops Windows taking snapshots of your screen to make your activity searchable, on PCs that support it.
tweaks.tradeoff: No Recall timeline.

tweaks.name: Turn off Cortana
tweaks.what: Removes Cortana and its background process on Windows versions that still include it.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: No feedback requests
tweaks.what: Windows stops asking how it's doing.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: Turn off OneDrive
tweaks.what: Stops OneDrive starting and syncing in the background, which can eat disk and upload bandwidth mid-game.
tweaks.tradeoff: Files stop syncing to OneDrive. Files already on this PC stay where they are.

tweaks.name: Turn off automatic maintenance
tweaks.what: Stops Windows' nightly maintenance (disk optimization, scans, update cleanup) starting while the PC is idle, which can spill into a gaming session.
tweaks.tradeoff: SSD TRIM and update cleanup no longer run on their own. Run Optimize Drives yourself every few weeks.

tweaks.name: Disable telemetry services
tweaks.what: Disables the Connected User Experiences service and the WAP push service that sends diagnostic data to Microsoft.
tweaks.tradeoff: None you'll notice. Takes effect after a restart.

tweaks.name: Disable offline maps updates
tweaks.what: Stops the service that downloads map data for the Maps app.
tweaks.tradeoff: Offline maps won't update.

tweaks.name: Disable Fax
tweaks.what: Disables the Fax service.
tweaks.tradeoff: You can't send faxes from this PC.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Insider service
tweaks.what: Disables the service used for Insider preview builds.
tweaks.tradeoff: You can't join the Insider program until it's back on.

tweaks.name: Disable store demo mode
tweaks.what: Disables the service that runs the demo mode shown on PCs in shops.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: Disable Media Player sharing
tweaks.what: Disables Windows Media Player's network sharing service.
tweaks.tradeoff: Media Player can't share your library on the network.

tweaks.name: Disable parental controls service
tweaks.what: Disables the Family Safety monitoring service.
tweaks.tradeoff: Microsoft Family limits on this PC stop working. Skip this on a child's PC.

tweaks.name: Disable Payments and NFC
tweaks.what: Disables the secure element service used for tap-to-pay.
tweaks.tradeoff: Tap-to-pay with this PC stops working.

tweaks.name: Disable diagnostics hub collector
tweaks.what: Disables a diagnostics collector used by developer tools.
tweaks.tradeoff: Some Visual Studio profiling tools won't work.

tweaks.name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.what: SysMain preloads apps into memory based on what you use. On an SSD the gain is small, and on some PCs it causes bursts of disk use.
tweaks.tradeoff: Apps you open often may start a little slower, especially from a hard drive. Takes effect after a restart.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Search indexing
tweaks.what: Stops the indexer reading your drives in the background.
tweaks.tradeoff: Start menu and File Explorer search for files becomes much slower. App search still works.

tweaks.name: Disable error reporting
tweaks.what: Crashes are no longer collected and uploaded in the background.
tweaks.tradeoff: Microsoft and app makers don't get your crash reports, so fixes for your exact crash may come later.

tweaks.name: Disable Xbox services
tweaks.what: Disables Xbox Live sign-in, cloud saves and accessory services.
tweaks.tradeoff: Game Pass, Xbox app games and Xbox controllers' extra features stop working. Skip this if you use any of them.

tweaks.name: Disable location service
tweaks.what: Disables the service apps use to find where you are.
tweaks.tradeoff: Maps, weather and Find my device can't use your location.

tweaks.name: Disable compatibility assistant
tweaks.what: Stops Windows watching programs for compatibility problems and offering to re-run them with fixes.
tweaks.tradeoff: No automatic compatibility prompts for old programs.

tweaks.name: Disable mobile hotspot
tweaks.what: Disables the service that shares this PC's connection as a Wi-Fi hotspot.
tweaks.tradeoff: Mobile hotspot in Settings stops working.

tweaks.name: Disable diagnostic policy service
tweaks.what: Disables the service behind Windows troubleshooters and problem detection.
tweaks.tradeoff: Troubleshooters in Settings won't work.

tweaks.name: Disable smart cards
tweaks.what: Disables smart card readers.
tweaks.tradeoff: Work or school smart cards stop working on this PC.

tweaks.name: Disable printing
tweaks.what: Disables the Print Spooler. Fewer services running, and it closes a part of Windows that has had serious security bugs.
tweaks.tradeoff: You can't print, or print to PDF, until you turn it back on.

tweaks.name: Turn off transparency
tweaks.what: Removes the blur behind the taskbar, Start and Settings. Frees a little GPU time on integrated graphics.
tweaks.tradeoff: Windows looks flatter.

tweaks.name: Turn off window animations
tweaks.what: Windows open, close and minimize instantly instead of animating.
tweaks.tradeoff: Less polish. Takes effect after you sign out.

tweaks.name: Open menus instantly
tweaks.what: Removes the 400 ms pause before submenus open.
tweaks.tradeoff: Submenus open as soon as you hover, which some people find busy.

tweaks.name: Turn off Peek
tweaks.what: Hovering the corner of the taskbar no longer fades every window to show the desktop.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: No desktop icon shadows
tweaks.what: Removes the drop shadow under desktop icon labels.
tweaks.tradeoff: Labels can be harder to read on busy wallpapers.

tweaks.name: No recommendations in Start
tweaks.what: Hides recommended files and apps in the Start menu.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: Drag windows as an outline
tweaks.what: Shows just the window frame while you drag it, instead of redrawing the whole window.
tweaks.tradeoff: Dragging looks old-fashioned. Takes effect after you sign out.

tweaks.name: Icons instead of thumbnails
tweaks.what: File Explorer shows file icons instead of generating thumbnails, which speeds up big photo and video folders.
tweaks.tradeoff: You can't preview images by their thumbnails.

tweaks.name: Turn off the advertising ID
tweaks.what: Apps can no longer use your Windows advertising ID to show you personalized ads.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: No tips, suggestions or sponsored apps
tweaks.what: Stops Start suggestions, Settings promotions, tips notifications and apps that install themselves.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: No tailored experiences
tweaks.what: Microsoft stops using your diagnostic data to pick tips and offers for you.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: No web results in Start search
tweaks.what: Start search only looks at your PC, so it stops waiting on Bing and returns results faster.
tweaks.tradeoff: Web searches go through your browser instead. Takes effect after you sign out.

tweaks.name: No activity history
tweaks.what: Windows stops recording which apps and files you use.
tweaks.tradeoff: None on current Windows versions.

tweaks.name: No ads on the lock screen
tweaks.what: Turns off the rotating Spotlight pictures and the tips and promotions printed over them.
tweaks.tradeoff: Your lock screen shows a fixed picture.

tweaks.name: No app launch tracking
tweaks.what: Windows stops recording which apps you open to sort Start and search.
tweaks.tradeoff: Most-used apps in Start won't update.

tweaks.name: Leave the improvement program
tweaks.what: Opts this PC out of the Customer Experience Improvement Program.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: No app compatibility telemetry
tweaks.what: Stops the inventory collector that reports installed programs for compatibility analysis.
tweaks.tradeoff: None.

tweaks.name: Minimum diagnostic data
tweaks.what: Sets diagnostic data to the lowest level your edition of Windows allows.
tweaks.tradeoff: On Home editions this is the same as Required. Some Insider features need more.

tweaks.name: Stop recording file access times
tweaks.what: Windows writes a timestamp every time a file is read. Turning that off cuts small writes during loading screens.
tweaks.tradeoff: Backup and cleanup tools that sort by last opened lose that information.

tweaks.name: Stop creating short file names
tweaks.what: Windows creates an old DOS-style short name for every new file. Turning that off saves work in folders with thousands of files.
tweaks.tradeoff: Very old 16-bit programs may not find files. Existing short names stay.

tweaks.name: Turn off Memory Integrity and VBS
tweaks.what: Virtualization-based security costs some CPUs 5 to 15% in games. Microsoft itself suggests gamers can turn it off. This does both parts.
tweaks.tradeoff: Removes a layer of protection against kernel-level malware. A few anti-cheats and work devices require it. Takes effect after a restart.

tweaks.name: Turn off Spectre and Meltdown protections
tweaks.what: Removes the CPU security patches that slow down older Intel processors, mostly 6th to 9th generation. Newer CPUs fix this in hardware and gain little.
tweaks.tradeoff: Malicious code, including in a web page, could read memory it shouldn't. Only for a PC used for games and nothing sensitive. Takes effect after a restart.

leftOut.name: RAM cleaners
leftOut.why: Windows already uses free memory as cache. Emptying it makes the next load slower, not faster.

leftOut.name: Turning off Windows Defender
leftOut.why: Tamper Protection switches it back on, and the scan cost during games is small. Add your game folders as exclusions in Windows Security instead.

leftOut.name: HPET, dynamic tick and platform clock (bcdedit)
leftOut.why: On current hardware these make no difference or make frame times worse.

leftOut.name: TCP window, IRPStackSize and other network packs
leftOut.why: Windows tunes these automatically and does it better than a fixed value.

leftOut.name: Realtime process priority
leftOut.why: It can starve the mouse, keyboard and audio drivers and freeze the PC.

leftOut.name: Deleting services or Windows components
leftOut.why: It can't be undone cleanly and breaks updates. Framecalm only switches services to Disabled.

leftOut.name: Reserved bandwidth (QoS) tweaks
leftOut.why: Windows doesn't actually hold back 20% of your bandwidth. Setting the limit to zero changes nothing for games.

leftOut.name: Disabling paging executive or large system cache
leftOut.why: Leftovers from Windows XP. On current Windows they either do nothing or take memory away from games.
